capabilities: Adjust the editor line width by dragging a slider in the status bar
Set a per-file editor width via an editor-width YAML field
Apply width changes to the editor in real time
extras: The README is titled 'Line Width Slider' while the plugin id is editor-width-slider; installation is manual via GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian's editor line width is fixed in settings, so changing it requires digging into menus and it cannot differ per file.
summary: Editor width tool that adjusts the editor line width with a slider in the status bar and per-file values via YAML.
